# License and attribution of `vacv_external.csv`

The records are **derived from ChEMBL** (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/), which is distributed under the
[Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/).
The file `vacv_external.csv` is a derivative work (selection, unit conversion, pairing of IC50/CC50, SMILES
standardisation) and is therefore shared under the **same license, CC BY-SA 3.0**.

Attribution: Mendez D. et al., "ChEMBL: towards direct deposition of bioassay data", Nucleic Acids Res. 2019, 47(D1):D930-D940.
Each record keeps the DOI of the original publication (`doi`) and the ChEMBL identifiers (`record_id`, `document_id`,
`assay_id`, `ic50_activity_ids`, `cc50_activity_ids`) so that every number can be traced back to its source.

The source code of this repository is not covered by this notice.
